title: 第7章 寻宝鼠发现端倪陆成的计划第8章 墨大师考核陆成的见解
slug: 凡人修仙我让高冷女宗主孕气十足
content_zh:
陆成望着寻宝鼠向屋内爬去，心里一惊！
这畜生难道闻出了极品丹药的气息？
他的脸色逐渐难看下来。
若是储物袋被找到，那他的极品丹药定会被发现，甚至连破碗的秘密都会被发现。
匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪！
届时，陈泽定会强行抢走这两样东西，破碗的功能太过逆天，他也定会被杀人灭口。
对方是炼气五层，自己是炼气三层，哪怕有象甲功，偷袭下说不定可以一试！
陈泽将陆成的神情尽收眼底，脸上冷笑逐渐收敛，冷哼一声向陆成屋内走去。
陆成望着陈泽的背影，眼底寒光闪过，双手逐渐紧握，体内象甲功功法逐渐催动！
“吱吱！”
陈泽刚走到门口，屋内突然传来寻宝鼠兴奋的尖叫！
接着，寻宝鼠嘴里含着一颗蓝色废丹，从门缝中爬出，对陈泽举起前爪，手舞足蹈，然后用爪子指向屋内。
陈泽将寻宝鼠举在掌心，寻宝鼠张开口，吐出丹药。
陆成看到这一幕，眸内杀机快速隐去。
陈泽打量着掌心寻宝鼠吐出的蓝色废丹，神情阴沉不定，他深深地看了陆成一眼。
陆成连忙假装露出惶恐之色，一副担心的模样。
陈泽冷哼一声走向屋内，顿时一股混杂着焦糊与霉变的气味扑面而来，令人作呕。
他看到了桌子上的数十颗废丹。
寻宝鼠看到主人走进屋内，更加兴奋，前爪颇有灵性地指向杂物桌后面的杂物，嘴角发出“吱吱吱”的叫声，仿佛在诉说什么！
陆成站在他的身后，象甲功再次催动，双手逐渐附上一层白色灵力铠甲。

陈泽目光在屋内扫了一眼，嫌弃地捂住鼻子，连忙退出屋子，斜眸道：“这些废丹你不焚烧，放屋里做什么？”
陆成一愣，深深地看了一眼寻宝鼠，连忙解释道：“我觉得这些废丹已成型，但被当作完全炼废，烧之可惜，便收藏了起来。”
陈泽嫌弃地看了陆成一眼，随手将废丹扔至脚下，掉头离去“哼，都是些垃圾，跟你一样，都是废物！！”
而他肩膀的寻宝鼠看到陈泽掉头走了，尖叫声更刺耳了，它双目更是露出愤怒的神色，前爪子拍打着胸口，一副气死鼠的模样。
陈泽伸手抚摸着它的脑门，道：“乖，咋不吃那些垃圾，回去给你丹药吃！”
寻宝鼠听到此话，瞬间两眼一翻，头耷拉下来，伸出前爪狠掐着鼻中，一副无奈摸样。
陆成望着陈泽离去的背影，目光望向他肩膀上寻宝鼠的神情，眉头微皱。
寻宝鼠定是发现了他藏在屋内的储物袋，只不过它不会口吐人言，陈泽认为是寻宝鼠想吃那些废丹而兴奋。
他手上和屋内残留着极品夺灵丹的丹香，这才被寻宝鼠发现。
幸好在陈泽来之前，他突然想到了这一点，又在屋里放了十颗废丹，掩盖气味。
待陈泽彻底消失后，废丹院再次回归寂静。
陆成望着陈泽消失的地方，紧了紧握住的双手，逐渐松开。
陈泽那目中无人的眼神和嘲讽他的话回荡在耳边，方才那一刻，他差点忍不住要催动【象甲功】与他好好一战！
但他不能，必须忍着！
现在的他太弱了，杀章南和那两个劫修，便会引来外门弟子来查案，若杀死一个外门弟子。
这事可就大了，林倾月未必会保他。
content_en:
Lu Cheng was shocked as he watched the treasure-hunting rat crawling into the house!
Could this beast smell the scent of the best elixir?
His face gradually turned ugly.
If the storage bag is found, his top-grade elixir will definitely be discovered, and even the secret of the broken bowl will be discovered.
The common man is not guilty, but he is guilty of carrying a jade!
By then, Chen Ze will definitely take away these two things by force. The function of the broken bowl is too unnatural, and he will definitely be killed and silenced.
The opponent is at the fifth level of Qi refining, and he is at the third level. Even if he has the Elephant Armor Technique, he might be able to give it a try under a sneak attack!
Chen Ze took in Lu Cheng's expression, the sneer on his face gradually faded, and he walked towards Lu Cheng's room with a cold snort.
Lu Cheng looked at Chen Ze's back, a cold light flashed in his eyes, his hands gradually clenched, and the Elephant Armor Skill in his body gradually activated!
"Squeak!"
As soon as Chen Ze walked to the door, the treasure hunter's excited screams suddenly came from inside the house!
Then, the treasure-hunting rat crawled out from the crack in the door with a blue waste pill in its mouth, raised its front paws towards Chen Ze, danced, and then pointed its paws into the house.
Chen Ze held the treasure-hunting rat in the palm of his hand. The treasure-hunting rat opened its mouth and spit out the elixir.
When Lu Cheng saw this scene, the murderous intent in his eyes quickly disappeared.
Chen Ze looked at the blue waste elixir spit out by the treasure hunter rat in his palm, with a gloomy expression on his face. He took a deep look at Lu Cheng.
Lu Cheng quickly pretended to be scared and worried.
Chen Ze snorted coldly and walked into the house. Suddenly, a smell of burnt and mildew hit his face, which was nauseating.
He saw dozens of waste pills on the table.
The treasure-hunting mouse became even more excited when he saw his owner walking into the house. His front paws pointed at the debris behind the utility table intelligently, and he made a "squeak" sound from the corner of his mouth, as if he was telling something!
Lu Cheng stood behind him, activated the Elephant Armor Skill again, and his hands were gradually covered with a layer of white spiritual armor.
Chen Ze glanced around the room, covered his nose in disgust, and quickly exited the room, squinting and asking: "If you don't burn these waste elixirs, why are you keeping them in the house?"
Lu Cheng was stunned, took a deep look at the treasure-hunting rat, and quickly explained: "I think these waste elixirs have been formed, but they were treated as completely refining waste and it was a pity to burn them, so I kept them."
Chen Ze glanced at Lu Cheng with disgust, threw the waste elixir at his feet, turned around and left, "Humph, they are all rubbish, just like you, they are all rubbish!!"
When the treasure-hunting rat on his shoulder saw Chen Ze turn around and leave, its screams became even more harsh. Its eyes showed an angry look, and it slapped its chest with its front paws, looking like a very angry rat.
Chen Ze reached out and stroked its forehead and said, "Hey, why don't you eat that garbage? I'll give you the elixir when I go back!"
When the treasure rat heard this, he rolled his eyes instantly, drooped his head, stretched out his front paws and pinched his nose, looking helpless.
Lu Cheng looked at Chen Ze's leaving back, looked at the expression of the treasure hunter on his shoulder, and frowned slightly.
The treasure-hunting rat must have found the storage bag he had hidden in the house, but it couldn't speak human words. Chen Ze thought it was because the treasure-hunting rat was excited to eat those waste elixirs.
The fragrance of the best spiritual elixir remained on his hands and in the house, and only then was he discovered by the treasure-hunting mouse.
Fortunately, before Chen Ze came, he suddenly thought of this and put ten more waste pills in the room to cover up the smell.
After Chen Ze completely disappeared, the Feidan Courtyard returned to silence again.
Lu Cheng looked at the place where Chen Ze disappeared, tightened his hands and gradually loosened them.
Chen Ze's arrogant eyes and mocking words echoed in his ears. At that moment, he almost couldn't help but urge him to activate the [Elephant Armor Skill] to have a good fight with him!
But he can't, he must endure it!
He is too weak now. Killing Zhang Nan and the two robbery cultivators will attract the outer disciples to investigate the case. If he kills an outer disciple.
This matter is serious, and Lin Qingyue may not protect him.
